common.note: Pick the occasion, choose a design, type your details and download the card as a picture or PDF. Everything is made on your device: your text and photo are never uploaded.
common.designHint: Designs marked "Suggested" suit the occasion you chose. Every design works for every occasion.
common.detailsHint: Everything is optional. A box left empty is left out of the card. You can type in Hindi too, but the fancy fonts only have English letters, so Hindi uses a plain system font.
common.heading: Small heading
common.footer: Last line (RSVP, dress code, from the family)
common.textSizeHint: The text is made smaller automatically if it does not fit.
common.photoHint: Add a photo of the couple, the child or your shop. It is placed above the names and stays on your device.
common.readFail: That file could not be read as a picture. Try a JPG, PNG or WebP photo.
common.failed: The file could not be made. Try a smaller photo.
common.startedAgain: Everything is back to the starting card.
common.printNote: For printing, choose Print and the PDF: it is sharp up to A5 and fine for A4 flyers.
notes: The card is a picture, so it cannot hold clickable links. Put the map link in your WhatsApp message.
Fonts and pictures are drawn on your device, so there are no logos, watermarks or sign-ups.
common.sampleNote: The names and details shown are only a sample. Replace them with your own.
